content.text: A lawk ka longkawi e tamipathu hlak,
mathoe laihoi yuemkamcu hringnae ahawihnawn.
Panuenae tawn laipalah hringnae hai hawi hoeh,
a khok a hue ka rang e hai a payon thai.
A pathunae ni lamthung a payon sak teh,
a lungthung hoi BAWIPA ouk a taran.
Hnopai ni huiko moi a sak,
hatei tamimathoe teh a hui ni a ceitakhai.
Ka panuekkhaikung kaphawk teh rek laipalah tâcawt mahoeh,
laithoe ka dei e hai hlout mahoeh.
Tami kapap ni bawi e lungyouk hanelah a kâcai awh,
poehno ka poe e tami hai tami pueng ni a kamyawngkhai.
Tamimathoe teh a hmaunawngha pueng ni hai a hmuhma,
a huinaw natawng teh ahlanae koe doeh hoe ao awh,
lawkkanem lahoi a pâlei ei nakunghai hoe a yawng takhai awh.
Lungangnae ka hmawt e ni hringnae a lungpataw teh,
thaipanueknae ka pâkuem e ni hnokahawi a hmu han.
Ka panuekkhaikung kaphawk teh rek laipalah tâcawt mahoeh,
laithoe ka dei e hai a rawk han.
Hringnawmnae heh tamipathunaw hanelah kamcu hoeh,
san ni khobawi a uk e heh hoe kamcu hoeh.
Poukpanueknae ka tawn e ni a lungsaw sak teh,
kâtapoenae ka pahnim pouh e teh ama ka bawilen sakkung doeh.
Siangpahrang lungkhuek e teh sendek ka huk e patetlah ao,
hatei a ngaikhainae teh hram dawk
ka bawt e tadamtui patetlah ao.
Capa ka pathu e teh a na pa hanelah
thoenae kaphawtkung lah ao teh,
lai ka roe e yu teh tui ka yu e patetlah ao.
Im hoi tawntanae teh napanaw koehoi coe e râw doeh,
hatei yu kahawi teh BAWIPA koehoi e doeh.
Thathoenae ni ihmu a tho sak,
ka pangak e teh a vonhlam han.
Kâpoelawk ka tarawi e teh a hringnae a ring,
hatei ka pahnawt e teh a due han.
Tamimathoe ka pahren e teh BAWIPA koe a cawi sak toe,
a poe tangcoung e hno hah bout poe lah ao han.
Ngaihawinae ao navah na capa hah yue haw,
a kahma nahanelah pouk hanh.
A lung puenghoi ka khuek sak e ni reknae a kâhmo han,
bangkongtetpawiteh, na rungngang nakunghai
boutbout rungngang a ngai han doeh.
Kâpankhainae hah thai haw, cangkhainae hah dâw haw,
bangkongtetpawiteh, hmalah na lung a ang han.
Tami e lungthin ni hno moikapap a kâcai,
hatei BAWIPA e khokhangnae dueng doeh kangning han.
Tami ni a ngai poung e teh pahrennae hah doeh,
laithoe dei e hlak mathoe e ahawihnawn.
BAWIPA takinae ni hringnae koe lah a ceikhai,
hote hringnae ka tawn e teh a lung a kuep vaiteh,
hnokathout ni thosin mahoeh.
Tami ka pangak ni a kut a kâyap teh
rawca a kâtu hane boehai ngai hoeh.
Ka dudam e tami hah hem haw,
kamawngrame tami teh a kâhlaw yawkaw han doeh,
a lungkaang e tami hah yue haw patopatang han
Na pa roedeng ka poe ni teh manu ka hrek e teh,
yeiraiponae hoi min mathoenae ka phawt e capa doeh.
Ka capa cangkhainae thai e heh na kâhat payon pawiteh,
lungangnae lamthung na phen han doeh.
Cungkeihoehe kapanuekkhaikung ni
lawkcengnae kalan a dudam teh,
tamikathout e pahni ni payonpakainae a payawp.
Lawkcengnae heh kadudamnaw hanelah hruek e lah ao teh,
hemnae bongpai teh tamipathunaw e hnukthun hane doeh.
